---
title: "North Carolina 2026 US Senate Results"
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

County-level vote margins from the November 3, 2026 North Carolina general election (Roy Cooper vs. Michael Whatley), using official precinct results from the [NC State Board of Elections](https://www.ncsbe.gov/results-data/election-results/historical-election-results-data).

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

# Sum US Senate votes by county and party
senate_county <- read_tsv("data/results_pct_20261103.txt") |>
  filter(`Contest Name` == "US SENATE") |>
  summarize(votes = sum(`Total Votes`), .by = c(County, `Choice Party`)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Choice Party`, values_from = votes, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(
    total = DEM + REP + LIB + GRE,
    dem_margin = (DEM - REP) / total * 100
  )

# Load built-in NC county boundaries and join election results
nc_map <- st_read(system.file("shape/nc.shp", package = "sf"), quiet = TRUE) |>
  mutate(County = toupper(NAME)) |>
  left_join(senate_county, by = "County")

# Plot county vote margins (blue = Cooper/DEM lead, red = Whatley/REP lead)
ggplot(nc_map, aes(fill = dem_margin)) +
  geom_sf(color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#b2182b",
    mid = "#f7f7f7",
    high = "#2166ac",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-50, 50),
    oob = scales::squish,
    breaks = c(-40, -20, 0, 20, 40),
    labels = c("R+40%", "R+20%", "Even", "D+20%", "D+40%"),
    name = "Margin"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 NC U.S. Senate Election Margin by County",
    subtitle = "Roy Cooper (D) vs. Michael Whatley (R)",
    caption = "Source: NC State Board of Elections (Nov. 3, 2026)"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm")
  )
```

## Georgia

```{r}
# Load Georgia county boundaries
ga_map <- st_as_sf(maps::map("county", "georgia", plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE))

# Plot Georgia county map
ggplot(ga_map) +
  geom_sf(fill = "gray95", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Georgia Counties",
    caption = "Source: maps package"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
